modifications: Removed coincident duplicate and covered backing triangles before optimization.
Recomputed and smoothed normals; simplified meshes with protected borders.
Replaced vertex-color finishes with named PBR paint, trim, opaque glass, alloy, tire and lamp materials. Lamp finishes are illustrative.
Centered on ground, rotated +Z forward and uniformly scaled to 5.05968 m reference length.
Added eleven empty anchor nodes and Draco geometry compression.
interiorDescription: Exterior shell with opaque windows. No usable seats, dashboard or rear-cabin geometry. Cabin cameras frame the exterior window area; cabin anchors are visual approximations.

coordinateSystem.origin: Ground at center of exterior bounding box including mirrors

rendering.recommendedEnvironment: Studio IBL; neutral soft key light; ACES filmic tone mapping

limitations: Artist title 2023; US MY2024 is the reference/data scope, not certified US geometry. Plate shapes and equipment may depict another market.
Exterior only. No opening doors, animated steering, functioning charge socket or exploded battery.
Paint, lens and material finishes are authored visualization choices, not official BMW paint or option availability.
No BMW website imagery, hidden configurator model or textures used.
Organizer permission request has no verified response; licence is the artist-offered CC BY 4.0.
Source has some panel faceting and simplified opaque lamp shapes; this is an interactive artist model, not BMW visualization CAD.
